giver: A stylesheet where a rule does nothing and nobody can say whether it lost or never matched.
object: Take two selectors that set the same property on the same element and compute both specificity triples by hand, including any :has(), :is(), :not() and :where().
done: You have both triples, the winner, and the column that decided it. PROBE under ?dev agrees with you.
produces: an answer, checkable against the machine
note: The only quest on the board with an oracle: the browser already knows and will tell you whether you were right.
